about: The build order is fixed: Kuwait, then Saudi Arabia, then the rest of the GCC, then the United States, then Iraq, then Egypt, then GDPR, then one unified checklist across all of them. A jurisdiction is active once its control data, rules and checks are in the repo and pass the tests. Framework versions are pinned from the regulator's own publication when that phase is built.
